changes.old: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting $s1 Shadow damage every $t sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by $s2% for $d.
changes.new: Tears the target apart from within for $d, inflicting $s1 Shadow damage every $t sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage $s2% faster.

changes.new: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by $s1% per each of your Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of ${$m1*3}%.
